events.title: Senate adjourned (Senate Daily Press Gallery log)
events.official_text: 8:15 p.m. The Senate stands adjourned until 10:15 a.m. on Wednesday. With Leader remarks reserved, the Senate will proceed to morning business. At 11:30 a.m. the Senate will proceed to up to three roll call votes. Motion to invoke cloture on the MTP to H.R.7008, Stop Insider Trading Act. (If cloture is not invoked) Motion to invoke cloture on the MTP to H.R.9340, Ratepayer Protection Act. (If cloture is not invoked) Motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor. Majority Leader Thune wrapped up. The following bills received their first reading: S. 5602 – A bill to prohibit the use of federal funds for any structure of monument at memorial circle at Lady Bird Johnson Park in the District of Columbia. Passed by unanimous consent: S.528 – the GLRI Act of 2025,with the Peters substitute amendment. Passed by unanimous consent: S.1574 – Tribal Access to Electronic Evidence Act, with the Cortez-Masto substitute amendment. Passed by unanimous consent: H.R. 5284 – Claiming Age Clarity Act. Passed by unanimous consent: H.R. 1190 – Expanding Access to Capital for Rural Job Creators Act. Passed by voice vote: S.5600 – To Reauthorize the Traumatic Brain Injury Program. Agreed to en bloc by unanimous consent: S. Res. 922, S. Res. 923, S. Res. 924, S. Res. 925, S. Res. 926, S. Res. 927, S. Res. 928. Agreed to by unanimous consent: S. Res. 652 – A resolution honoring the life and service of United States Marine Corps veteran Nicholas Douglas Quets, expressing condolences to his family, and condemning cartel violence. Passed by unanimous consent: H.R. 1744 – United States Commission on International Religious Freedom Reauthorization Act of 2026 Passed by unanimous consent: H.R. 10159 – To authorize the Secretary of the Army to convey to the State of North Carolina a certain parcel of real property located at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, on which the State shall construct a veterans’ State home, and for other purposes.
